{"article_id":"Art. 30","resource_uri":"onedrive://legal/contracts/core-banking-ledgercore.md","start":25,"end":50,"quote":"25: ## 5. Service levels
26: Service level: 99.9% availability with quantitative performance targets, reviewed every year.
28: ## 6. Assistance in ICT incidents
29: The Provider assists PayRo at no additional cost during any ICT incident affecting the ledger.
31: ## 7. Cooperation with competent authorities
32: The Provider fully cooperates with the competent authorities and resolution authorities.
34: ## 8. Termination
35: PayRo may terminate with 180 days' notice or immediately for material breach.
37: ## 9. Security awareness and training
38: The Provider takes part in PayRo's ICT security awareness programmes and digital operational resilience training.
40: ## 10. Notice and reporting obligations
41: The Provider notifies PayRo of any development with a material impact on the agreed service levels.
43: ## 11. Business contingency and security measures
44: The Provider implements and tests business contingency plans and maintains ICT security measures and policies.
46: ## 12. Threat-led penetration testing
47: The Provider participates and cooperates in PayRo's threat-led penetration testing (TLPT).
49: ## 13. Audit, access and inspection rights
50: PayRo, an appointed third party and the competent authority have unrestricted rights of access, inspection and audit, on-site and remote.","obligation":"The Core Ledger Software-as-a-Service Agreement complies with Art. 30 requirements for contracts supporting critical or important functions, including service levels, reporting, contingency plans, TLPT participation, and audit rights.","action":"CONTRACT_REVIEW","confidence":1}
